description: This file defines Express.js route handlers for the dashboard modules API endpoints, including fetching overview metrics and counts related to users, tenants, projects, sessions, deployments, and costs. It imports models and services, handles asynchronous data fetching, and provides JSON responses for frontend consumption.

methods.name: GET /api/dashboard/overview/modules
methods.description: Handles GET requests to fetch overview module metrics and items, including counts of users, tenants, projects, sessions, deployments, and aggregated costs and session durations.

methods.name: GET /api/dashboard/overview/metrics
methods.description: Handles GET requests to fetch total counts for users and deployed apps, with fallback logic to infer user count from session tracking if the users collection is empty.
